name: Federal onshore (BLM)

agency.name: Bureau of Land Management, U.S. Department of the Interior

form.name: Application for Permit to Drill or Reenter (APD); Sundry Notices and Reports on Wells
form.notes: Read both blank forms (edition October 2024, expiring Oct 31, 2027; 3160-5 at https://www.blm.gov/sites/blm.gov/files/3160-005.pdf) and Onshore Oil and Gas Order No. 1 (72 FR 10308, March 7, 2007; https://muleapi.blm.gov/sites/default/files/Order_1_2007.pdf) for the APD package: well plat, Drilling Plan, Surface Use Plan of Operations (SUPO), bond, operator certification. Drilling Plan and SUPO contents in the cells come from Order 1 III.D.3 and III.D.4; Order No. 2 and 43 CFR 3170 were not read in full. The form instructions say operators must file electronically in AFMSS (43 CFR 3171.5) since May 13, 2017; that system is login-only and was not opened. 3160-3 has no APD number, operator ID, fee, receipt date or spud date; the approval date sits in the 'Approved by' block.

api_number.n: Item 9 'API Well No.' (asked on the APD; not published per well)

permit_number.n: No APD-number item on 3160-3; AFMSS assigns its own ID (not verified, login-only)

lease_name.n: Item 8 lease name; item 5 lease serial no.; item 7 unit or CA agreement

operator_id.n: 3160-3 asks the name only; an AFMSS operator ID was not verified (login-only)

operator_type.n: Not on 3160-3 (name, address and phone only: items 2, 3a, 3b)

bond.n: Item 20 'BLM/BIA Bond No. in file'; bond is attachment 4 of item 24

district.n: Aggregate only: State Office (monthly PDFs), Field Office (Table 16 xlsx); no per-APD row

surface_latlon.n: Surveyor plat plus geospatial data in NAD83 lat/long (Order 1 III.D.2); no 3160-3 item

surface_plss.n: Item 4 'At surface'; item 11 Sec., T., R., M. or Blk. and Survey; footages on plat

lateral_path.n: Directional design, plan view, vertical section in the Drilling Plan (Order 1 III.D.3.i)

elevation.n: Item 21 'Elevations (Show whether DF, KDB, RT, GL, etc.)'

surface_owner.n: SUPO: surface access agreement or bond if surface is private (Order 1 III.D.4); no form item

well_type.n: Item 1b: Oil Well, Gas Well or Other

work_type.n: Item 1a: DRILL or REENTER; sundry 3160-5 adds deepen, recomplete, plug back and more

well_direction.n: No checkbox; directional or horizontal design goes in the Drilling Plan (Order 1 III.D.3.i)

proposed_depth_md.n: Item 19 'Proposed Depth' (form does not say measured or vertical)

proposed_depth_tvd.n: True and measured depths in the directional design (Order 1 III.D.3.i); item 19 unspecified

lateral_length.n: No item; only implied by the directional plan attachment

target_formation.n: Drilling Plan lists formations and expected oil or gas zones (Order 1 III.D.3.a-b); form: Field and Pool

formation_tops.n: Names and estimated tops of formations in the Drilling Plan (Order 1 III.D.3.a)

casing_program.n: Drilling Plan: size, grade, weight, thread, depth, hole size per string (Order 1 III.D.3.d)

cement_program.n: Drilling Plan: cement type, amount, yield, top and excess per string (Order 1 III.D.3.e)

pressure_control.n: Drilling Plan: BOP and diverter specs, pressure rating, test plan (Order 1 III.D.3.c)

h2s.n: Drilling Plan: expected pressures and hazards incl. H2S, with mitigation (Order 1 III.D.3.h)

pit_waste.n: SUPO: waste containment and disposal, reserve pit construction and lining (Order 1 III.D.4.g)

water.n: SUPO: water source, haul route and transport method; volume not named (Order 1 III.D.4.e)

fracture_plan.n: Item 1c 'Hydraulic Fracturing' box; item 24 cites 43 CFR 3162.3-3 'as applicable'

frac_dates.n: Forms 3160-4 and -5 have no job start or end date; a notice of intent takes a free-text estimated start only

frac_chemicals.n: No federal disclosure rule since 2017; Form 3160-4 item 27 asks only the date of a FracFocus upload, where required

frac_additives.n: Forms 3160-4 and -5 ask no trade name, supplier or purpose of any fracturing product

frac_amounts.n: Form 3160-4 item 27 gives one amount and type of material per interval, not per chemical

spacing_unit.n: Item 17 spacing unit; item 16 acres in lease; item 7 unit or CA agreement

spacing_exception.n: No item; Order 1 variances (sec. X) are a separate request, not read in full

mineral_owner.n: Item 5 Lease Serial No. and item 6 Indian allottee or tribe; lessor is Federal or Indian

fee.n: Not a 3160-3 item; BLM counts an APD as received only once its fee is paid (report note)

notice_hearing.n: 30-day public posting (Order 1 III.E.1); report listed at reports.blm.gov, not openable here

date_received.n: Form has the signature date only; monthly PDFs give COUNTS received (fee paid), no per-APD date

date_approved.n: 'Approved by' date block on the form; public only as monthly COUNTS by state office

date_expires.n: No field; Order 1 III.G: valid 2 years; status reports cite 3 to 4 years for newer APDs

spud_date.n: Not on 3160-3 or -5; BLM counts wells spud per FY by state (Table 8) and field office (Table 16)

completion_date.n: Not on 3160-3 or -5 (3160-5 cites completion report 3160-4); counts only, in Table 16

status.n: Public only as counts (pending, processed, approved, available to drill); per-APD status not seen

plat_image.n: Certified well plat is a required attachment (Order 1 III.D.2); no public image found

form_image.n: AFMSS filing is login-only; no public application images found

completion_report.n: 3160-5 says Form 3160-4 is filed after testing; not found online

logs.n: Not checked; no public BLM well-log source found

production_link.n: No BLM production link found; the statistics page points to revenuedata.doi.gov

grade_reason: No free per-APD or per-well file with an approval date was found. What exists: (1) monthly APD status PDFs with counts of APDs received, pending, processed and approved by nine BLM state offices (Federal and Tribal lands together; new drill and re-entry together), monthly from April 2021 (February and March 2021 as one two-month report); (2) an annual workbook (Table 7) with Federal APDs approved by the state the well is in, FY2001 to FY2025 (FY2019 to FY2025 totals: 3,181; 4,226; 4,914; 2,852; 3,519; 3,322; 5,740; New Mexico: 1,420; 2,460; 2,441; 1,862; 2,354; 2,241; 4,327); (3) Table 16 by field office with wells spud and completed. That is grade C: aggregates in PDF and Excel. The AFMSS 2 public reports on reports.blm.gov ('Approved APDs Report - Federal', '30 Day Federal Public Posting') may be per-APD, which would be grade A, but the plain request ended at a login redirect to an internal host, so it is unverified.
producer_plan: Answer to the key question: monthly APDs APPROVED by the state the well is in, back to 2019, is NOT available free. Monthly counts exist only by BLM state office and only from April 2021 (Feb-Mar 2021 as one report; Oct 2020 to Jan 2021 only cumulative; FY2019 and FY2020 only annual). No file splits by action type (new drill, re-entry, sundry). Plan for the best fragment: (1) scrape the APD page for its PDF links (65 files) and download each once, 4 s or more apart (about 0.2 MB each); (2) run pdftotext -layout (poppler, already used by d7_packs.py via pdftoppm); (3) read the FIRST table of each file (the month named in its title, e.g. '9/1/2026 to 9/30/2026'), matching the nine office names (Alaska, California, Colorado, Eastern States, Montana, Nevada, New Mexico, Utah, Wyoming) and the 'Federal Well Total' and 'Indian Well Total' rows; column order changes: 2021 files read Received, Approved, Processed, AAPD, Pending; 2023 onward read Received, Pending, Processed, Approved, Available. Match columns by heading, not position; (4) check each month sum against the file's own fiscal-year-to-date table and against Table 16 (annual; FY2025 matched on received and approved, processed differed by 7), keep the newest value; (5) label the series 'BLM state office', not 'state'. Table 7 shows the offices mix states: the New Mexico office includes the Oklahoma Field Office (FY2025 Federal approvals 46 = OK 20 + KS 0 + TX 26 in Table 7) and the Montana office includes North Dakota (FY2025: 204 = MT 8 + ND 196). Use Table 7 only for annual, Federal-only, true-state splits. Counts are APDs, not wells: one pad can hold several APDs, and a Master Development Plan approves many at once. Monthly PDFs include Indian-land APDs and are revised ('accurate on the date it is pulled'). The fiscal year runs October to September. Do next, by hand: open reports.blm.gov/reports/AFMSS in a real browser once; if 'Approved APDs Report - Federal' shows API number, operator and approval date and exports CSV or Excel, regrade to A and build monthly counts by state from it. Idea, unverified: state agencies' permit files (ND, WY, CO, UT, NM) may flag federal minerals and could give by-state monthly counts of permits on federal land.
privacy_notes: Files read (monthly PDFs, statistics workbooks, the lease layer's field list) hold counts and lease-case fields only: no individuals' names, phone numbers or addresses. The forms ask for the operator's address and phone (items 3a, 3b) and the notice of staking asks for a surface owner's name and phone, so per-APD records inside AFMSS would hold contact details; none are published in what I read. The AFMSS public reports were not opened, so whether they list operator names (possibly sole proprietors) is unknown.
